a.xlink:title: Prerequisite header file for GROMACS build.
This file declares functions for (mostly) the domdec module to use MPI functionality.
Declares structures related to domain decomposition.
Basic types and macros used throughout GROMACS.
Declares gmx::ArrayRef.
Wraps mpi.h usage in Gromacs.
Declares the MpiComm class.
Provides templated functions to map C++ types to MPI datatypes.
Declares implementation functions and types for the domain decomposition module.
Declares the DomdecZones class and helper structs.
Declares gmx::Range.

Declares gmx::HostAllocationPolicy, gmx::HostAllocator, gmx::HostVector and gmx::PaddedHostVector, which are used to make/be standard library containers that can allocate memory suitable for transfers. Currently the only supported transfers using pinned memory are to CUDA GPUs, but other possibilities exist in future.
Defines interaction types and parameters.
Declares real and related constants.

Declares an allocator that can use default initialization instead of values initialization. This is useful for improving performance of resize() in standard vectors for buffers in performance critical code.
Defines assert macros customized for Gromacs.
Declares GMX_CURRENT_FUNCTION for getting the current function name.
Declares gmx::PaddedRVecVector.
Declares allocation policy classes and allocators that are used to make library containers compatible...
Declares gmx::Allocator template whose allocation functionality is configured both by type of object ...
Declares common exception classes and macros for fatal error handling.
Declares interaction functions.
Defines helper types for class enumerations.
This file declares functions for timing the load imbalance due to domain decomposition.
This file declares functions for mdrun to call to manage the details of its domain decomposition...
Declares the UpdateGroupsCog class for managing centers of mass of update groups. ...
High-resolution timestamp or CPU clock cycle counters.
Declares common utility classes and macros.
Declares gmx::FixedCapacityVector.
Declares gmx::ListOfLists.
Declares the DeviceBuffer data type.
Defines structures and functions for mapping from keys to entries indices using a hash table...
